Apple (AAPL) Holder Umb Bank N A Boosted Position; Kroger (KR) Holder Bowen Hanes & Co Has Lowered Its Holding
May 12, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Umb Bank N A increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.8% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Umb Bank N A bought 3,660 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 462,430 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $78.26M, up from 458,770 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Umb Bank N A who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.95B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $188.59. About 25.70M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Bowen Hanes & Co Inc decreased its stake in Kroger (KR) by 75.78% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bowen Hanes & Co Inc sold 25,045 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.92% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,005 shares of the food chains company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $220,000, down from 33,050 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bowen Hanes & Co Inc who had been investing in Kroger for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $20.99 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.86% or $0.21 during the last trading session, reaching $24.57. About 4.48M shares traded. The Kroger Co. (NYSE:KR) has declined 18.87% since May 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 30.42% the S&P500.
